generated.details: The panels are thick rectangular felt pads with softly rounded edges and narrow mounting gaps.
Its two sealed glass bulbs join through a narrow waist, with pale sand pooled inside and a flat lower end supporting it upright.
Place the matte ivory ceramic ornament on the left tabletop, slightly farther back: a small continuous ceramic arch with two flat feet.
At far right beside the desk, the unlit floor lamp has a slim stem joining a weighted round base to a linen drum shade.
